# Discord Timestamp Generator

> Discord Timestamp Generator (https://disctimestamps.site) is an open-source, client-side web utility and developer documentation hub for creating dynamic Discord timestamps (<t:TIMESTAMP:STYLE>), converting Unix epoch times, and formatting Discord markdown messages.

## Core Utility & Functionality
- **Syntax:** `<t:1700000000:R>` where `1700000000` is the Unix epoch timestamp in seconds, and `R` is the format flag.
- **Client-Side Guarantee:** 100% of timestamp calculations run locally in the browser JavaScript runtime. No dates, times, or personal data are sent to any external server.
- **Timezone Adjustment:** Timestamps dynamically render in the recipient's local timezone and device clock across Discord desktop, web, iOS, and Android clients.

## All 7 Discord Timestamp Formats
- `t`: Short Time (e.g., 9:41 PM)
- `T`: Long Time (e.g., 9:41:30 PM)
- `d`: Short Date (e.g., 11/14/2023)
- `D`: Long Date (e.g., November 14, 2023)
- `f`: Short Date/Time (default style if omitted, e.g., November 14, 2023 9:41 PM)
- `F`: Long Date/Time with Day of Week (e.g., Tuesday, November 14, 2023 9:41 PM)
- `R`: Relative Time countdown/countup (e.g., in 2 hours, 5 minutes ago)

## Core Documentation & Developer Tools
- [Homepage / Live Generator](https://disctimestamps.site): Interactive generator with datepicker, timezone selector, presets, live chat simulator, and 1-click copy.
- [Discord Embed Generator](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-embed-generator): Visual Discord embed maker and webhook builder with real-time dark mode chat simulation, custom colors, inline fields, and 1-click code export (Webhook JSON, discord.js v14, discord.py).
- [Discord Glitch & Zalgo Text](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-glitch-text): Client-side Unicode combining diacritics generator with intensity slider, directional toggles, and Discord 32-character nickname limit validator.
- [Discord Colored Text (ANSI)](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-colored-text): Visual ANSI escape sequence formatter for Discord codeblocks with 8 text colors and background highlights.
- [Discord Snowflake Decoder](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-snowflake-to-timestamp): 64-bit Snowflake ID decoder to extract creation dates and timestamps from User, Message, and Server IDs.
- [Discord Timestamp Guide](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-timestamp-guide): Comprehensive tutorial on how Discord dynamic timestamps work, syntax breakdown, and troubleshooting.
- [Timestamp Formats & Styles](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-timestamp-formats): Cheat sheet and comparison of all 7 Discord timestamp style flags.
- [Unix Timestamp Guide](https://disctimestamps.site/unix-timestamp): Unix epoch guide, seconds vs. milliseconds explanation, and timezone offsets.
- [Discord Markdown Guide](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-markdown): Formatting guide for bold, italic, spoilers, headers, code blocks, and dynamic time integration.
- [Discord Webhook Timestamps](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-webhook-timestamps): Guide for embedding dynamic timestamps in webhooks and bot JSON embeds.
- [Discord Bot Timestamps](https://disctimestamps.site/discord-bot-timestamps): Code snippets and libraries for Discord.js, Discord.py, and REST API automation.
- [Blog / Technical Guides](https://disctimestamps.site/blog): Developer articles, moderation tutorials, and scheduled event walkthroughs.
